warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.00 + 3.00 (6.00); y = A-B-C-D at 3.50 + 3.50 + 3.50 (10.50). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, both S-02 views, S-03, S-04 (C-D only), A-02 and A-07. Vector PDF (page /Rotate 180, rendered upright); every value read off the rendered page.

Truss panel chains are positioned per section 4 rule 4: T2 (0.50 x 12, S-03) and T3 (0.750 x 8, S-04) run along rows B and C between the T1 trusses on grids 1, 2, 3, so their ends are grids 1 and 3; T1 (1.167 x 6, S-04) runs from T3 (row C) to the อะเส (row A) with T2 at mid-length (row B). Every tick became a line — that is why the 1-2 gap carries ten dummies (1' at -1.00 through 1'''''''''' at 2.50) and the 2-3 gap seven.
A''' (2.30, S-02 beam line) and A'''' (2.334, Truss T1 panel point) are 0.034 apart — kept both: different things (a floor beam vs a roof-truss panel point), positioned off different printed chains.
3' (6.50) vs 3'' (6.60): S-02 prints 0.50 beyond grid 3 to the centre of the bump-out's B2 beam; A-02 and A-07 print 0.60 to the outer wall edge. Two different edges, both kept.

D''' (11.70) carries the 1.20 printed beyond D on S-02 (ground floor), A-02 (both floors), A-07 รูปตัด B and A-08; the second-floor structure plan prints 1.10 instead (D'', 11.60 = centre of the outer balcony beam) and the S-04 roof plan 1.30 (D'''', 11.80 = roof edge).

Conflict, decided: A-08 (แปลนบันได ST-01) labels its grid bubble 'C', but the stair it draws (1.200 deep, running 3.000 from grid 1 to grid 2) sits beyond row D on S-02 (both views, B1 stub to 1.20 beyond D at grid 1), A-02 (both plans) and A-07 รูปตัด B. Four sheets against one: the stair chain is positioned against D (D' = 10.60 for the printed 0.100, D''' = 11.70 for 1.200). confidence of D' lowered.

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนน (A-07). Three levels are all printed 'ระดับหลังคา' (+5.85, +6.13, +6.71) — their ids keep the printed value so they stay distinct. Beam tops +0.10 / +2.75 print only as numbers in the beam tags, so their ids are null.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-04, S-06..S-08 plus A-02 (floor plans), A-07 (building sections, for levels) and A-08 (stair ST-01). The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-03 roof plan, A-04..A-06 elevations, A-09, A-10, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run. S-06..S-08 print only member-internal dimensions (cap sizes, pile spacing, section sizes, slab thicknesses), which stay on their elements. The S-05 sheet listed in the A-01 index is not in the downloaded set.
